name: Adam
summary: A lightweight full-size humanoid from Beijing's PNDbotics, using cable-driven joints for smooth, compliant motion. Adam drew attention at CES 2025 playing keyboard in a live band, and the company also sells 'Adam-U', a stationary dual-arm version aimed at teleoperated data collection for training manipulation models.
notable: Cable-driven joints for compliant, lifelike motion
Live musical performance demo at CES 2025
